subject: proto and zoo among 10 most downloaded packages on CRAN

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: proto and zoo among 10 most downloaded packages on CRAN
parts:
Just noticed that based on the number of downloads from January-May 2013, from the R Studio CRAN mirror as discussed in this blog post:

http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/2013/06/a-list-of-r-packages-by-popularity.html

that the proto package and the zoo package are among the 10 most downloaded packages on CRAN.
